# Visual-review photo fixture

`visual-review-cc0.jpg` comes from the existing approved image-quality QA fixture,
whose recorded CC0 source is https://pxhere.com/en/photo/1102099 .

This is a sports/jersey photograph, not an image of the clubs in the fictional
Match previews and not the user's missing original reference background.
It was resized proportionally to 1920px wide, with no cropping or invented detail,
and exported as JPEG 97 / 4:4:4 / sRGB with no EXIF for a bounded CI fixture.
No AI enhancement, upscaling, face restoration or generative processing was used.

Only QA preview generation uses it; production backgrounds and templates are
unchanged. The generated bundle is explicitly marked fictional and pending user
approval. Do not publish the sample results as real news.
